name: orbital-3d-web
description: Orbital — an immersive 3D web experience powered by a hand-rolled, dependency-free canvas 3D engine with a rotating particle sphere, orbital rings, parallax starfield and drag-orbit interaction

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import {cpSync} from 'fs'; import {resolve} from 'path'; cpSync(resolve('public'), resolve('dist/public'), {recursive: true}); console.log('Copied public to dist/public')"
